parameters.name: IPPrefix
parameters.description: IPv6 prefix. {{empty}} indicates that it matches all destination prefixes (i.e. equivalent to "::/0"). All bits to the right of the prefix MUST be zero, e.g. 2001:edff:fe6a:f76::/64. Routes with a 128-bit prefix length (/128) are host routes for a specific IPv6 destination, e.g. 2001:db8:28:2:713e:a426:d167:37ab/128.

parameters.name: NextHop
parameters.description: IPv6 address of the next hop.

parameters.name: MTU
parameters.description: Maximum Transmission Unit for this link (expressed in {{units}}). {{range}}

object.description: This object models IPv6 network information that the Cellular modem received from the network.
